</nowiki><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ Bombs apply their effects 3t (1.8s) after being thrown
⬥ Bombs have a cast range of 9 tiles and spread over a 3x3 area
</nowiki></div><nowiki>
</nowiki><div><div><div><u><nowiki>Ways to Throw Bombs</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>1) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Option 1: Default Action Bar Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Throws at target
    • Does not show quantity on action bar
2) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Option 2: Targeted Action Bar Mode</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Throws at selected tile
    • This allows for pre-bombing
    • Shows quantity on action bar
3) </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Click from inventory</nowiki></strong><nowiki> - Throws at target
</nowiki></div></div><div><div><u><nowiki>List of Notable Bombs</nowiki></u><nowiki>
</nowiki></div><div class="pvme-source-preserve-lines"><nowiki>⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Vulnerability Bomb</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074235129858.png?v=1" alt="vulnbomb" title="vulnbomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - applies </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> (10% damage increase)
    • Casts </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/537349530551582720.png?v=1" alt="Vuln" title="Vuln" kind="icon" /><nowiki> 3 times, once every 0.6s
    • Hitchance is equal to current accuracy against target
⬥ </nowiki><strong><nowiki>Sticky Bomb</nowiki></strong><nowiki> </nowiki><pvme-image src="https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/655341074306301964.png?v=1" alt="stickybomb" title="stickybomb" kind="icon" /><nowiki> - binds monsters standing in it (lasts 6s)
</nowiki></div></div></div><nowiki>
